schema:
CREATE TABLE Award (
  award,
  award_category,
  award_id,
  episode_id,
  organization,
  person_id,
  result,
  role,
  series,
  year
);

CREATE TABLE Credit (
  category,
  credited,
  episode_id,
  person_id,
  role
);

CREATE TABLE Episode (
  air_date,
  episode,
  episode_id,
  episode_image,
  number_in_series,
  rating,
  season,
  series,
  summary,
  title,
  votes
);

CREATE TABLE Person (
  birth_country,
  birth_name,
  birth_place,
  birth_region,
  birthdate,
  height_meters,
  name,
  nickname,
  person_id
);
